svg.title: Illustrative comparison of imputation strategies
svg.desc: English translation of an illustrative chart. Original bars, axes, score values, and retained-sample percentages are preserved exactly. All data are invented.
svg.text: Choosing a strategy for handling problematic cells
Each strategy has its own configuration space. The criterion combines the mean and 90th percentile
of the absolute correlation differences with the retained sample size.
Distance from the pairwise Spearman correlation matrix (lower is better)
Illustrative data. Values of m considered: {2, 5, 10, 15}.
